1. Getting Started

1.1 About the App

The U-Tapao PMIS mobile app is the field version of PMIS. It works on Android phones (installed app) and on iPhone (web app added to the Home Screen). Both versions have the same screens and use the same PMIS account. What you can do in each menu depends on your PMIS role.

MenuWhat it does
RIT FieldInspections assigned to you. Enter the result, photos and signature on site, even without signal.
AttendanceClock in and clock out at site, and see your monthly summary.
My TasksDocuments waiting for you: RIT, MAR, RFA, RFI and letters.
PhotoRecord a site observation (safety or general) with up to 20 photos and share it with the team.
Daily AIAI summary of the daily reports, and the location and work of each DWR and DRQ document.
Site MapYour location, the construction blocks, and colleagues who share their location.
Note: You need a PMIS user ID and password. Ask the PMIS administrator if you do not have one. People and documents in the pictures of this guide are samples.

1.2 Install on Android

Scan the QR code with the phone camera, or open the install page below. The page always links to the newest app.

Scan to install
https://dongcheolchoi-dot.github.io/utprw-pmis-app/install.html
  1. 1Tap Download Android app. The file name ends in .apk.
  2. 2Open the downloaded file. If Android says the browser is not allowed to install apps, tap Settings, turn on Allow from this source, then go back and tap Install.
  3. 3Open the app, log in, and allow camera, location and notifications when the phone asks.
Note: If the phone shows "App not installed", an older test version is still on the phone. Uninstall the old U-Tapao PMIS app once, then install again.
Note: Google Play Protect may warn that the app is unknown. The app is the official U-Tapao PMIS app; tap More details, then Install anyway.

1.3 Install on iPhone

On iPhone the app is a web app that you add to the Home Screen. Use Safari; other browsers on iPhone cannot add it.

Scan to install
https://dongcheolchoi-dot.github.io/utprw-pmis-app/install.html
  1. 1Scan the QR code with the iPhone camera and open the page in Safari.
  2. 2Tap Open the app.
  3. 3Tap the Share button (square with an up arrow) at the bottom of Safari, then Add to Home Screen, then Add.
Note: Always start the app from the U-Tapao PMIS icon on the Home Screen, not from a Safari tab. Your login and the data saved for offline use stay with the icon.
Note: If the camera or location does not work, open iPhone Settings, Safari (or Privacy and Security, Location Services), and allow access.

1.4 Log In and Choose a Language

  1. 1Choose the language: KO, EN or TH. You can change it later at the top of every screen.
  2. 2Enter your PMIS user ID.
  3. 3Enter your password.
  4. 4Keep me signed in on this device: choose 1 day or 7 days. Use it only on your own phone.
  5. 5Tap Sign In.
  6. 6Settings: connection test and server address. Use it only when the administrator asks.
Note: If you forget your password, ask the PMIS administrator to reset it.

1.5 Top Bar

  1. 1Connection status. ONLINE means data is sent at once; OFFLINE means your work is saved on the phone and sent later.
  2. 2Language: KO, EN, TH.
  3. 3Notifications. A red number shows unread notifications.
  4. 4Refresh the current screen. A number on it shows items waiting to be sent.
  5. 5Settings: notifications, app update and connection test.
  6. 6Log out.

1.6 Bottom Menu

  1. 1RIT Field: your inspections.
  2. 2Attendance: clock in and clock out.
  3. 3My Tasks: documents waiting for you. The red number is the count.
  4. 4Photo (large button): record a site observation with photos.
  5. 5Daily AI: daily report summary and work by document.
  6. 6Site Map: location and construction blocks.

1.7 App Updates

Screen updates download automatically while the app is online. On Android, close the app completely and open it again to use the new screen. If a banner says a new app is needed, tap Download new app and install it over the old one; you do not need to uninstall first. On iPhone, the app updates itself when you open it with an internet connection.

2. Daily Work

2.1 RIT Field: Inspection List

The list shows the RIT inspections assigned to you. It is saved on the phone, so you can read it without signal.

  1. 1Search by RIT number, subject or location.
  2. 2Status of the inspection.
  3. 3Open the request document (IN), photos or the closed document.
  4. 4RE only: choose an inspector and tap Assign.
  5. 5Tap Inspect to enter the result.
Note: "Other Disc." means the inspection belongs to another discipline. You can still read it; check with your RE before entering a result.

2.2 RIT Field: Enter the Result

  1. 1Choose the result code: 1 Approved, 2 Approved with Comments, 3 Rejected or 4 Canceled.
  2. 2Insert Standard Remark adds a ready-made comment.
  3. 3Write your remarks.
  4. 4Camera: take a photo now.
  5. 5Gallery: choose photos already on the phone. Up to 10 photos; tap ✕ to remove one.
  6. 6Sign with your finger. Clear starts again.
  7. 7Tap Submit Inspection.
Note: Without signal the result is saved on the phone and a yellow waiting box appears on the list. It is sent automatically when the phone is online again. Do not clear the app data or uninstall the app while results are waiting.

2.3 Attendance: Clock In

  1. 1Current site time (Thailand, GMT+7).
  2. 2Tap Clock In when you start work.
  3. 3Your attendance this month.

2.4 Attendance: Clock Out

  1. 1Your clock-in time.
  2. 2Write today's main work. It is required to clock out.
  3. 3Tap Clock Out.
Note: If you forgot to clock in or out, send a correction request to the administrator from PMIS on a computer (attendance panel on the dashboard).

2.5 My Tasks

  1. 1Filter by type: All, RIT, MAR, RFA, RFI or Letter.
  2. 2Each card shows the document, status, due date and person in charge.
  3. 3Open File opens the document.
Note: Reviews and approvals of MAR, RFA, RFI and letters are done in PMIS on a computer. The app shows what is waiting for you.

2.6 Daily AI: Summary

  1. 1Choose a date.
  2. 2Or tap a recent date. If today has no summary yet, the latest one is shown.
  3. 3Numbers of the day: work reports (DWR), work plans (DRQ), manpower and equipment.
  4. 4AI summary of progress.
  5. 5Safety patrol and QC points for the day.

2.7 Daily AI: Work Report (DWR)

Scroll down below the summary to see each document of the day.

  1. 1Work Report DWR: work done.
  2. 2Work Plan DRQ: work planned.
  3. 3Filter by discipline (EAR, DRN, PAV and others).
  4. 4Weather, total manpower and equipment, by trade and by equipment type.
  5. 5Location of the work.
  6. 6Work activities.
  7. 7PDF opens the signed document.
Note: Text is shown in your language when an AI translation exists; otherwise the original text is shown. C means the document is completed, P means pending.
Note: PDF files open in Google Drive. You need a Google account that has access to the file.

2.8 Daily AI: Work Plan (DRQ)

  1. 1Start time and shift (☀️ day, 🌙 night).
  2. 2Planned work.
  3. 3Safety and QC point to check for this work.

2.9 Photo: New Site Observation

Tap the large Photo button in the bottom menu.

  1. 1Choose Safety / HSE or General monitoring.
  2. 2Write the location or block.
  3. 3Describe what you found.
  4. 4Camera: take a photo.
  5. 5Gallery: choose photos. Up to 20 photos per record.
  6. 6Time and GPS are added automatically. Tap Retry GPS if the location is missing.
  7. 7Tap Save & Share.

2.10 Photo: Sending in the Background

After Save the window closes and you can keep working. The record is saved first, then the photos are sent one by one.

  1. 1Progress, for example Uploading 1/4. "Waiting" means there is no signal; sending continues automatically. Tap it to try again now.
  2. 2Tap Photo again to record the next observation while sending continues.
Note: Keep the app open until sending finishes. If you close it, sending continues the next time you open the app. A notification tells you when all photos are saved.
Note: Photos are stored in the project Google Drive in one folder per record (month, day, record number).

2.11 Photo: Shared Feed

  1. 1Switch between New record and Shared feed.
  2. 2Filter: All, Safety / HSE or General. ↻ refreshes the feed.
  3. 3Each record shows the first photo, note, location, GPS and author.
  4. 4Open all photos of the record in Google Drive.

2.12 Site Map

  1. 1My location: find where you are.
  2. 2Inspectors: show or hide colleagues who share their location.
  3. 3Update location: send your position now.
  4. 4Share location: turn on to let the team see you. Your location is shared only while this is on and the app is open; it stops when you turn it off or log out.
  5. 5The construction block you are in, and your open RITs.
  6. 6Map with construction blocks. Tap a block to see its details.

2.13 Site Map: People Sharing Location

  1. 1Colleagues who shared their location in the last 12 hours. Tap a name to show the person on the map.

3. Notifications, Settings and Help

3.1 Notifications

Tap the bell at the top. The app checks for new items every few minutes while it is open: RITs assigned to you, new documents to review, deadlines, and finished photo uploads.

  1. 1A notification. Tap it to open the related screen.
  2. 2Mark all read.
Note: Notifications appear while the app is open. When the app is closed, open it to see new items.

3.2 Settings

Tap the gear button at the top.

  1. 1Test Connection: checks that the app can reach PMIS.
  2. 2Notification permission of the phone.
  3. 3Choose which notifications you want, with sound and vibration.
  4. 4How often the app checks (3 to 30 minutes).
  5. 5Check for updates of the app.
  6. 6Tap Save.
Note: Do not change the server address unless the PMIS administrator asks you to.

3.3 Troubleshooting

ProblemWhat to do
Android: "App not installed"Uninstall the old U-Tapao PMIS app once, then install again from the install page.
iPhone: no Add to Home ScreenOpen the page in Safari, not in LINE or Chrome. In LINE, tap ⋯ and Open in Safari.
Cannot log inCheck the user ID and password, and that the phone is online. Ask the administrator to reset the password.
Location shows No GPSTurn on location on the phone, allow location for the app, move to open sky, and tap Retry GPS or My location.
Photos stay "Waiting"Wait for signal and keep the app open, or tap the indicator to send now. Do not uninstall the app while photos are waiting.
PDF does not openSign in to Google with an account that has access to the project files, or ask DC for access.
New screen does not appearClose the app completely and open it again while online. In Settings, tap Check for updates.
Note: For other problems, contact the PMIS administrator with a screenshot of the screen.
